title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
A 23-year-old Chinese student is on trial in Zurich for attempted murder after stabbing three five-year-old boys at an after-school center in Oerlikon on 1 October 2024, China’s national day. The knife blade was about 8.5 centimeters long. One boy’s jugular vein was severed and required emergency surgery, another suffered two chest stabs that damaged his heart and major blood vessels and nearly died, and the third was injured in the ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker’s arms, making him drop the knife and surrender, and passersby held him until police arrived.

Prosecutors say he planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences of stabbing random victims, ordering clothes and a set of kitchen knives, studying anatomy, and buying raw beef to practice cuts. They describe him as extremely cold-blooded and say he acted from revenge, a need for recognition, and ideological delusion. The prosecution is demanding a 15-year prison sentence and a 15-year expulsion from Switzerland. He is due in court on Thursday.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
